```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidypopgen)
library(tidygenclust)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Set cores
n_cores <- 10
data.table::setDTthreads(n_cores)
bigparallelr::set_blas_ncores(n_cores)
```

```{r set-directories}
res_dir <- "../results/s05_fastmixture/"
```

This script uses fastMIXTURE (Santander et al., 2024) through the package tidypopgen (Carter and Manica, 2025) and clumppling (ref) through the package tidygenclust (ref) to estimate ancestry proportions of individuals in the global dataset. 

# Load gt

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <-
  gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_neo_clean.gt",
    reattach_to = "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_neo_clean"
  )
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% group_by(population)
```

# Loci and sample count

```{r}
nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
```

fastMIXTURE was run on the full, cleaned dataset of `r nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum)` individuals and `r count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)` SNPs.

```{r}
if (file.exists("../data/intermediate/fastmixture/fastmixture_m.RData")) {
  qmats <-
    readRDS("~/Dropbox/gitdata/malagasy_diversity/data/intermediate/fastmixture/fastmixture_m.RData")
} else {
  tictoc::tic()
  k <- c(2:10)
  qmats <- gt_fastmixture(mad_bor_g1000_sum,
    k,
    n_runs = 3,
    threads = 1,
    batches = 16,
    seed = c(1,2,3),
    no_freqs = TRUE
  )
  saveRDS(qmats, "../data/intermediate/fastmixture/fastmixture_m.RData")
  time <- tictoc::toc()
}
```

fastMIXTURE was run unsupervised for k values `min(range(unique(qmats$k)))` to `r max(range(unique(qmats$k)))`, with `r rle(qmats$k)$lengths[1]` repeats. 

```{r}
# check order
testthat::expect_equal(qmats$id, mad_bor_g1000_sum$id)
# add grouping variable
qmats$group <- mad_bor_g1000_sum$population
```

# Reorder the gt_admix object

```{r}
qmats <- gt_admix_reorder_q(qmats)
```


# Clumppling

```{r}
clump <- gt_clumppling(input_path = qmats)
```

```{r}
out <- clump %>% autoplot(type = "all_modes", group = qmats$group)
out
```

```{r}
clump %>% autoplot(type = "major_modes", group = qmats$group)
ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "clumppling_major_modes.jpg"),
  width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
clump_out <- clump %>% autoplot(type = "modes", group = qmats$group)
clump_out
ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "clumppling_modes.jpg"),
  width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
clump %>% autoplot(type = "modes_within_k", k = 3, group = qmats$group)
```


# Initial plot


```{r}
autoplot(get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 3, run = 1),
  data = mad_bor_g1000_sum,
  annotate_group = TRUE,
  arrange_by_group = TRUE,
  arrange_by_indiv = TRUE,
  reorder_within_groups = TRUE
)
```

# Add full population names 

```{r}
pop_names <-
  read.csv("../data/raw/data_input/igsr-1000-genomes-phase-3-release.tsv",
    sep = "\t"
  )

# find matching id in pop_names Sample.name and mad_bor_g1000_sum id, and for the matches, replace the population in mad_bor_g1000_sum with the population in pop_names
for (i in seq_len(nrow(pop_names))) {
  if (pop_names$Sample.name[i] %in% mad_bor_g1000_sum$id) {
    mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$id == pop_names$Sample.name[i], "population"] <- pop_names$Population.name[i]
  }
}

# replace "Luhya,Luhya" with "Luhya"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Luhya,Luhya"] <- "Luhya"
# replace "Esan,Esan" with "Esan"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Esan,Esan"] <- "Esan"
# replace "Gambian Mandinka,Gambian" with "Gambian Mandinka"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Gambian Mandinka,Gambian"] <- "Gambian Mandinka"
# replace "Mende,Mende" with "Mende"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Mende,Mende"] <- "Mende"
# replace "Kinh,Kinh Vietnamese" with "Kinh Vietnamese"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Kinh,Kinh Vietnamese"] <- "Kinh Vietnamese"
# replcae "Punjabi,Punjabi" with "Punjabi"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Punjabi,Punjabi"] <- "Punjabi"
# replcae "Benga,Bengali" with "Bengali"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Bengali,Bengali"] <- "Bengali"

# replace any _ with a space
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population <- gsub("_", " ", mad_bor_g1000_sum$population)
```

```{r}
# reorder
mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region <- "Other"
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("Borneo", "Sumba", "Timor"), "Region"] <- "Island southeast Asia"
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("Bengali", "Punjabi"), "Region"] <- "South Asia"
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("Southern Han Chinese", "Kinh Vietnamese"), "Region"] <- "East Asia"
# Not really happy about grouping all African samples here though...
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("Esan", "Gambian Mandinka", "Luhya", "Mende", "Yoruba"), "Region"] <- "Africa"
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego", "Sakalava Tsimihety", "Betsileo", "Vezo", "Mikea", "Temoro"), "Region"] <- "Malagasy"
# wharerver is left as "Other" set to Africa
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region == "Other", "Region"] <- "Africa"

mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% arrange(Region, population)
```

# Arrange and save plot

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% arrange(Region, population)
pop_levels <- unique(mad_bor_g1000_sum$population)

mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% filter(.data$id %in% qmats$id)
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum[match(qmats$id, mad_bor_g1000_sum$id), ]
pops <- mad_bor_g1000_sum$population
pops <- factor(pops, levels = pop_levels)

qmats <- gt_admix_reorder_q(qmats, group = pops)

autoplot(get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 3, run = 1),
  annotate_group = TRUE, arrange_by_group = TRUE,
  arrange_by_indiv = TRUE, reorder_within_groups = TRUE
)

#ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "fastmixture_autoplot.jpg"),
#  width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300
#)
```

# Check which ancestry components the .Q files represent 

```{r}
augmented <- augment(get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 3, run = 1),
  data = mad_bor_g1000_sum
)

# filter augmeneted to $population GWD and print head
augmented_gwd <- augmented %>% filter(population == "Gambian Mandinka")
head(augmented_gwd)

# filter augmented to $population Borneo and print head
augmented_borneo <- augmented %>% filter(population == "Borneo")
head(augmented_borneo)

# .Q3 representing Asian ancestry and .Q2 representing African ancestry
```

# Look at variance within each population

```{r}
vars <- augmented %>%
  group_by(population) %>%
  summarise(Q1 = var(.Q1), Q2 = var(.Q2), Q3 = var(.Q3))
head(vars)
```

```{r}
ggplot(vars, aes(x = population, y = Q1)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Variance of Q1 within each population",
    x = "Population", y = "Variance of Q1"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(vars$Q1) + 0.01))

ggplot(vars, aes(x = population, y = Q2)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Variance of Q2 within each population",
    x = "Population", y = "Variance of Q2"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(vars$Q2) + 0.01))

ggplot(vars, aes(x = population, y = Q3)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Variance of Q3 within each population",
    x = "Population", y = "Variance of Q3"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(vars$Q3) + 0.01))
```

## Recording R environment

Part of ensuring our workflow is reproducible is to keep track of the R environment.
We will automatically save our R environment into a file called `r_environment.json`.

```{r save-r-environment, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
filename_rmd <- "s05_fastmixture.Rmd"
filename_renv <- paste0(
  res_dir, "/renv_",
  tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filename_rmd)),
  ".json"
)
renv::lockfile_write(renv::lockfile_create(), file = filename_renv)

```
